CivilStatuses.StatusDefinition: Individuals not recognized within the civic framework or whose status has been revoked due to severe malcompliance, criminality, or other administrative factors.
Registered participants within the civic framework under Combine jurisdiction.
Citizens demonstrating reliable compliance, productivity & participation within the civic framework.
AdministrativeDirectives: Verbal correction preferred for minor violations

CivilStatuses.StatusDefinition: Citizens demonstrating sustained compliance, productivity & civic reliability.
Citizens designated as exceptionally valuable civic assets due to their utility, productivity, or contribution to sociostability.
AdministrativeDirectives: Eligible for highest authorized civic privileges
